title: Ragù alla Bolognese
description: Classic slow-cooked meat sauce from Bologna, perfect with tagliatelle.

steps.text: Warm {q:2,u:"tbsp",n:"olive oil"} in a heavy pot over medium heat; add the soffritto and cook until soft.
Add {q:400,u:"g",n:"ground beef"} and {q:200,u:"g",n:"ground pork"}; brown well, breaking up lumps.
Deglaze with {q:150,u:"ml",n:"dry white wine"} and reduce by half.
Stir in {q:700,u:"g",n:"tomato passata"}, {q:250,u:"ml",n:"beef stock"}, and {q:1,u:"piece",n:"bay leaf"}. Simmer gently 2–3 hours.
Finish with {q:200,u:"ml",n:"whole milk"}; season with {q:1,u:"tsp",n:"salt"} and {q:0.5,u:"tsp",n:"black pepper"}.

title: Tiramisù
description: Layers of espresso-soaked ladyfingers and mascarpone cream, dusted with cocoa.

steps.text: Brew {q:300,u:"ml",n:"unsweetened coffee"} and let it cool completely (cold coffee helps prevent soggy biscuits).
Separate the {q:4,u:"piece",n:"eggs"} into yolks and whites.
Whisk yolks with {q:100,u:"g",n:"caster sugar"} until the mixture is pale, thick, and airy.
Add {q:500,u:"g",n:"mascarpone"} (slightly softened) to the yolk mixture and mix just until smooth.
In a clean bowl, whip the egg whites to stiff peaks.
Gently fold the whipped whites into the mascarpone cream, working from bottom to top to keep the mixture fluffy.
Spread a thin layer of cream on the bottom of a ~20x20 cm dish to help the first layer adhere.
Quickly dip each savoiardo (smooth side) in the cold coffee—just a brief dip—and arrange them in a single layer without overlapping.
Cover the biscuits with a generous layer of cream, smoothing the surface.
Repeat with a second layer of briefly dipped savoiardi.
Finish with the remaining cream and level the top.
Refrigerate for about 3 hours (longer rest improves texture and flavor).
Just before serving, dust the surface evenly with {q:2,u:"tbsp",n:"unsweetened cocoa powder"}.

title: Pasta with Ragù
description: Tagliatelle tossed with rich Bolognese ragù and Parmesan.

steps.text: Bring {q:4,u:"l",n:"water"} to a rolling boil; salt with {q:1,u:"tbsp",n:"salt"}.
Cook {q:400,u:"g",n:"dried tagliatelle"} until al dente; reserve some cooking water.
Toss pasta with {q:600,u:"g",n:"ragù alla bolognese"}, loosening with cooking water as needed.
Serve and top with {q:40,u:"g",n:"Parmigiano Reggiano, finely grated"}.
